english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken rendering when someone sharply raises an eyebrow in a wry or expressive way.

examples.english: They quirk an eyebrow after hearing that and look at me with a half-smile.
examples.traditional: 佢聽完嗰句，挑起眉頭，似笑非笑咁望住我。
